rows.theAnswerToTheQuestionAsked: The honest answer is that this packet CANNOT pre-tick CR-65 Section V, and the packet now says so. The record does not establish every limb for the participant, and six of the eight limbs it establishes nothing about whatsoever.
rows.whyTheRecordDoesNotEstablishTheLimbs: AL.memo.json track al-pardoned-felony records waitingPeriods [] -- empty, so no 180-day period exists in the record at all -- exclusions [] empty, and exactly four participantInputs: pardonDate, restorationLanguage, firearmRightsExcluded, countyOfFiling. Nothing in the track speaks to a violent offense under § 12-25-32 (Box11.2), a sex offense under § 15-20A-5 (11.3), moral turpitude under § 17-3-30.1 or a 15-year arrest-free period (11.4), a serious traffic offense under Article 9 of Chapter 5A of Title 32 (11.5), or a commercial driver licence at the time of the offense (11.6). Box11.1's 180 days has no counterpart in the record. Box11.0, restoration of all civil and political rights, is not merely unestablished but is the OPEN question: the same memo carries it as a retained legal_design_blocker -- 'whether a pardon that withholds firearm rights satisfies the statutory restoration requirement remains dispositive and must be resolved before that branch ships' -- and as a stop condition, 'The pardon withholds firearm rights and the restoration question controls.' The route expressly contemplates that this box may be false. Box10.6, the route's defining disposition, also asserts restoration ('certificate of pardon WITH RESTORATION of civil and political rights'), and the memo's own limitation classifies it as the participant's fact: 'Pardon date, restoration language, and certificate terms are participant-entered facts.'
rows.howItWasRepaired: Not one of the eight is ticked any more. FAMILY_CONFIG['al-pardoned-felony-set'].selected in scripts/build-census-v1-al-diversion-set.mjs goes from eight boxes to []. Each of the eight now leaves the build as a refusal with refusalClass participant_sworn_narrative_or_legal_election and routeDetermined false, so the certification comes back to the participant instead of being made for them. participant-instructions.md gains a section, 'The eight conditions you must certify yourself', which quotes each limb as CR-65 prints it -- the printed wording read out of the form's own content streams -- and states beside each one what the held record does and does not say. Box11.0 is marked UNRESOLVED IN THE HELD RECORD and tells the participant that if the pardon excludes firearm rights they should not check it and should stop.

Telling the participant in step 3 to 'confirm every condition printed in CR-65 Section V', which the pre-repair packet did, does not cure ink already sworn on their behalf -- vf06 said exactly this and it is right.
